chapter: Army band, Lena Horne, Billie Holiday and the 1950s
title: Lena Horne years: scores, recordings, Nellie Lutcher, three months' advance pay
summary: He stayed almost four years, supervising her recordings (Sid Catlett suggested Nellie Lutcher as pianist) and received three months' advance pay while she married Lennie Hayton and traveled.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: So I had to check my head, you know. It wouldn't come out. So man, it was a lovely thing, and I made a lot of scores for her, and she paid me for all of them. I supervised her recordings, and on one of the sessions, guess who I had playing piano for me, and I was the conductor? Nellie Letcher.
: Oh really? I know Nellie, yeah.

Because we had something that needed to be directed, and I couldn't get back to the piano. So I had Big Sid Catlett Kaplan on the date, so it was decided that we would get a piano player, so I could conduct, you know, certain things, so I said, "Geez, I don't know anybody." Well, Big Sid Catlett Kaplan says, "Well, why don't you get my girlfriend?" I said, "Well, who is your girlfriend?" He says, "Nellie Letcher. Let me get her on the phone." Boom. That was it. So she came down in an hour.
Los Angeles. We were recording. We had the session, and it went beautiful.
: About how long did that -- how long were you working with her on that tour?
Well, I stayed with Lena almost four

years. We would tour, and then we'd come back to Los Angeles, and then -- well, she was great in every way. More than financially, you know. I'll tell you one thing she did. You know, she was a starlet, you know, at that time at MGM. So she did something. I don't know what it was, and there was a little suspension there, but it wasn't bad, but nevertheless she told me that she was gonna take off some time, about four or five months. Do you know, she paid me three months in advance? She said, 'I want you to be around when I come back. I'm going out of the States.' This is when she married Lennie Hayton.
